column1: # samples_cellranger.tsv — Sample sheet for prepare_cellranger.R
# Instructions:
#   - One row per sample (= one CellRanger run)
#   - Replace all placeholder values with your actual sample information
#   - Delete this comment block before use (lines starting with # are ignored
#     by read.table but keeping them clean avoids confusion)
#   - Save as tab-delimited (.tsv); do not convert to .csv
# Column descriptions:
#   sample_id         Unique label for this sample. Used as the CellRanger --id
#                     argument and as the output folder name under CELLRANGER_OUTDIR.
#                     No spaces or special characters.
#                     e.g. CTL_3m_30d_1
#   fastq_sample_name The sample name embedded in your FASTQ file names, passed
#                     to CellRanger --sample. Must match exactly what appears
#                     between the first and second underscore in the FASTQ filename.
#                     e.g. if your files are MySample_S1_L001_R1_001.fastq.gz
#                          then fastq_sample_name = MySample
#   Additional columns (add as many as needed):
#                     Any extra columns are automatically attached as per-cell
#                     metadata in the Seurat object and used as SCTransform
#                     covariates in pipeline.R. Name them to reflect your
#                     experimental design (e.g. age, treatment, batch).
sample_id
